rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone stubbornly refuses to stop, change, or give in.

example.english: They stubbornly refused to stop and kept scolding people.
example.traditional: 佢死都唔肯停低，仲要繼續鬧人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sei2 dou1 m4 hang2 ting4 dai1 zung6 jiu3 gai3 zuk6 naau6 jan2

rows.note: Use this when someone insists on doing something despite other people objecting or advising against it.

example.english: I told them not to go, but they stubbornly insisted on going.
example.traditional: 我叫佢唔好去，佢硬係要去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 heoi3 keoi5 ngaang6 hai6 jiu3 heoi3
